_comment: Player attributes (docs/20_PLAYER_MENU.md sections 3 and 12). Add, remove or reorder attributes here: the Status tab,
the level-up and the save follow without code changes. Items and equipment raise them through their "stats" in
effects: what each point ABOVE "base" gives, so a fresh Lv 1 character plays exactly as before. "per" may be a
fraction (0.5 ATK a point: 2 points = +1 ATK; the total is rounded down) or negative. The stats an effect can name:
atk, def        added to ATK / DEF
hitZone         widens the Attack bar's green zone (greenHalf, in bar units; it stays inside the blue zone)
cooldownMs      added to the bars' wait after a tap (battle.json bar_cooldown_ms; never below 200 ms)
skillPower      percent added to what skills (功法) give
goldGain        percent more gold from won battles
An empty effects list (or per 0) turns an attribute's gameplay off.
levelUp: EXP needed for the next level = lv * expPerLevel; atk/def/maxhp are what each level gives;
freePoints: attribute points the player places by hand on the Status tab each level (0 = none).
